nuggets.text: Kenneth Walker III, MVP of Super Bowl LX in February, signed with the Chiefs in March.
Andy Reid once said he ate 60 cheeseburgers while filming a State Farm commercial.
Patrick Mahomes' father Pat pitched in the major leagues, and Patrick pitched in relief for Texas Tech's baseball team.
Chiefs fans set a Guinness World Record at Arrowhead: 142.2 decibels on Monday Night Football in 2014.
The Chiefs' home is officially just 'Arrowhead Stadium' again in 2026, dropping the GEHA Field name.
Chiefs founder Lamar Hunt came up with the name 'Super Bowl' after seeing his kids play with a Super Ball.
The Chiefs are named for Kansas City Mayor H. Roe Bartle, whose nickname was 'Chief.'
The Chiefs began as the Dallas Texans and won the first-ever game against the Broncos, 17-14, back in 1960.
Xavier Worthy set the NFL Combine record in the 40-yard dash in 2024, running it in 4.21 seconds.
Travis Kelce passed Jerry Rice for the most career playoff catches in NFL history during the 2023 season.
